definition: a special way of doing something
sentence: The swimmer worked on her breathing {technique}.
translation: Пловчиха работала над техникой дыхания.

definition: something that is needed or that must be done
sentence: A passport is a {requirement} for the trip.
translation: Для поездки требуется паспорт.

definition: to touch someone with your lips to show love
sentence: She bent down to {kiss} the baby goodnight.
translation: Она наклонилась поцеловать малыша на ночь.

definition: a narrow way for walking, or the direction something moves in
sentence: A {path} leads from the gate to the front door.
translation: От калитки к входной двери ведёт дорожка.

definition: to change a text or film to make it better or shorter
sentence: I need to {edit} my essay before I hand it in.
translation: Мне нужно отредактировать эссе, прежде чем сдавать.

definition: a large road vehicle for carrying heavy goods
sentence: A {truck} delivered the new furniture.
translation: Грузовик привёз новую мебель.

definition: to say that someone is responsible for something bad
sentence: Don't {blame} me for the broken window.
translation: Не вини меня за разбитое окно.

definition: likely to cause harm or injury
sentence: It is {dangerous} to swim here when the sea is rough.
translation: Здесь опасно плавать, когда море неспокойно.

definition: very; to a very great degree
sentence: The exam was {extremely} difficult for everyone.
translation: Экзамен был чрезвычайно трудным для всех.

definition: used to make a statement stronger, or to show agreement
sentence: It was a very cold day {indeed}.
translation: День и в самом деле был очень холодным.

definition: a series of events that happen again and again in the same order
sentence: The {cycle} of the seasons never changes.
translation: Цикл времён года никогда не меняется.

definition: to finish your studies at a university or school and get a degree
sentence: She will {graduate} from university next summer.
translation: Следующим летом она окончит университет.

definition: loved very much, or used at the start of a letter
sentence: She is a very {dear} friend of mine.
translation: Она мой очень дорогой друг.

definition: to raise something to a higher position
sentence: Can you help me {lift} this box onto the shelf?
translation: Поможешь мне поднять эту коробку на полку?

definition: coming after four others in order
sentence: This is her {fifth} visit to Japan.
translation: Это её пятый визит в Японию.

definition: to move people or goods from one place to another in a vehicle
sentence: Trucks {transport} the fruit from the farms to the city.
translation: Грузовики перевозят фрукты с ферм в город.

definition: a warning or a danger that something bad will happen
sentence: Rain is the main {threat} to our picnic plans.
translation: Дождь — главная угроза нашим планам на пикник.

definition: the work of a teacher, or the ideas a person or religion teaches
sentence: She went into {teaching} after ten years as an engineer.
translation: После десяти лет работы инженером она стала преподавать.

definition: honest and direct, even when it is not pleasant
sentence: I'll be {frank}: I didn't like the food.
translation: Буду честен: еда мне не понравилась.

definition: a general direction in which something is changing or developing
sentence: Working from cafes is a big {trend} in our city.
translation: Работать из кафе — большой тренд в нашем городе.

definition: a little, by a small amount
sentence: The soup is {slightly} too salty for me.
translation: Суп для меня немного пересолен.

definition: a picture made with paint, or the activity of making one
sentence: A large {painting} of the sea hangs above the fireplace.
translation: Большая картина с морем висит над камином.

definition: to disagree with a plan and try to stop it
sentence: Most of the neighbours {oppose} the new car park.
translation: Большинство соседей против новой парковки.

definition: the largest amount or number that something can hold
sentence: The hall has a {capacity} of two hundred people.
translation: Зал вмещает двести человек.

definition: something useful or valuable that a person or company owns
sentence: Her calm voice is a real {asset} in this job.
translation: Её спокойный голос — настоящее преимущество в этой работе.

definition: to politely say no to an offer or invitation
sentence: I had to {decline} the job because of the long commute.
translation: Мне пришлось отказаться от работы из-за долгой дороги.

definition: a plan for doing or organising something
sentence: The city started a {scheme} for cheap bike rentals.
translation: Город запустил программу дешёвой аренды велосипедов.

definition: a long period of history with its own character
sentence: Smartphones changed the way we live in one short {era}.
translation: Смартфоны изменили нашу жизнь за один короткий период.

definition: to make people notice the most important part of something
sentence: The report {highlights} three problems with the old system.
translation: В отчёте выделены три проблемы старой системы.

definition: something given, especially to a god, or a product offered for sale
sentence: The villagers left an {offering} of fruit at the temple door.
translation: Жители деревни оставили подношение из фруктов у дверей храма.

definition: a time when things are very bad or dangerous
sentence: We had a small {crisis} when the oven stopped working.
translation: У нас случился небольшой кризис, когда сломалась духовка.

definition: not normal, not what you expect
sentence: It's {odd} that he hasn't called all week.
translation: Странно, что он не звонил всю неделю.

definition: to give a document or form to a person in authority
sentence: I {submitted} my application ten minutes before the deadline.
translation: Я подал заявку за десять минут до дедлайна.

definition: completely necessary, so important you cannot do without it
sentence: Good shoes are {essential} for a long walk.
translation: Хорошая обувь необходима для долгой прогулки.

definition: a way of thinking about something from a particular position
sentence: Travelling gave me a new {perspective} on my own country.
translation: Путешествия дали мне новый взгляд на собственную страну.

definition: to refuse to accept an offer, idea or person
sentence: They {rejected} my offer without even reading it.
translation: Они отклонили моё предложение, даже не прочитав.

definition: easy to see or understand, clear to anyone
sentence: It's {obvious} that she likes you.
translation: Очевидно же, что ты ей нравишься.

definition: to give all your time and energy to one thing
sentence: She {dedicated} her whole weekend to fixing the bike.
translation: Она посвятила все выходные ремонту велосипеда.

definition: to come out from a place where you could not be seen
sentence: She {emerged} from the shop with four heavy bags.
translation: Она вышла из магазина с четырьмя тяжёлыми пакетами.

definition: a result of an action, often a bad one
sentence: Missing the bus had one {consequence}: I missed the interview.
translation: У опоздания на автобус было одно последствие: я пропустил собеседование.

definition: to post a short message on the social network X, formerly Twitter
sentence: The minister likes to {tweet} about every meeting he attends.
translation: Министр любит писать в соцсети о каждой встрече, которую посещает.
